producers: DAX Production|Dai Nippon Printing|MAGNET|Line Digital Frontier
synopsis:
Nobody wants "Grubby Forager" Rudd on their adventuring team. His nickname—and his stench—come from his constant treks into the Noxious Labyrinth to gather medicinal herbs, a job he survives only thanks to his status immunity skill. When he's finally recruited as a party porter, things seem to be looking up... Until a deadly dungeon monster appears and his fake allies use him as bait before abandoning him! Wounded, destitute, and barely surviving the attack, Rudd breaks a forbidden taboo to stay alive: eating monsters. But the more he devours, the more power he gains, kicking off a thrilling, adventurous gourmet fantasy!

(Source: Square Enix)

title: Osawaga! Super Baby
title_japanese: おさわがせ! スーパーベビー

title: Ingoku Danchi
synopsis:
Yoshida is a tiny, frail high school graduate who became an unwilling manager of an apartment complex when his father, the former manager, injured himself. Unbeknownst to him, this apartment complex houses quite a few women with very... unusual sexual preferences. This becomes a problem when a mysterious entity begins giving "Libido Cloth" to these women—skimpy outfits that give them superpowers and cause them to go on lewd rampages! Will Yoshida be able to stop them?

(Source: MU)

title: Taiheiyou Hikouki Ichibannori
title_english: The First Flight Across The Pacific Ocean
title_japanese: 太平洋飛行機一番乗り

title: Zui Hou Jue Ding Ai Shang Ni
synopsis:
Two strangers, both proposed marriage to their respective girl/boyfriend, were rejected on the same day. They decided that the best way to deal with the rejection was to get drunk, real drunk. During the 24 hours of their crazy drunkenness, these two stranger became fast friends and got married... to each other. When they finally sobered up, they embarked on a mission to undo every crazy thing they did while they were drunk and prayed that their girl/boyfriend don't find out.

(Source: MyDramaList)

title: Dogulwang
synopsis:
Undercover behind enemy lines, Jooheon's newest plan to torment TKBM will involve taking them down from the inside! Stealing their relics and causing infighting is just the tip of the iceberg on what he'll do to make the group pay for their sins. But with the appearance of the Tower of Pride, Jooheon's skills in rage-baiting will truly be tested as he must pit the most fearsome warlords against each other! Will Jooheon Suh come out on top in the battle of the greatest conquerors of history?

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Sinbi Apartment 10-junyeon Geugjangpan: Han Beon Deo, Sohwan
title_english: Shinbi's Haunted House: One More Summon
title_japanese: 신비아파트 10주년 극장판: 한 번 더, 소환

title: Iwamoto-senpai no Suisen
synopsis:
The 1910s. Iwamoto Kodo, a student at Suho Junior High School under direct command of the army, is investigating paranormal phenomena across the country as per military instruction. In a village rumoured to have "black snow," he meets a boy with special powers who believes them to be an illness; through Iwamoto's support, he realises they might have something in common and receives a recommendation to the school. Mysteries await Iwamoto at each place he visits–a romantic tale of this era begins to unravel!

(Source: MAL News)

title: Zero Rise
synopsis:
Zero Rise is about a group of young athletes who have lost their place in the basketball world due to past mistakes and harsh realities. In a society where the divide between wealth and poverty is stark, these determined players must battle against the odds in a cutthroat underground league known as "Zero Rise." As they fight not only for their dreams but for redemption and a shot at a brighter future, they must navigate treacherous challenges that demand both skill and integrity. In this unforgiving world, they are forced to discover what it truly means to rise from the streets—leaving them with one final question: will they find their second chance, or will the rules of survival break them?

(Source: MAL News)

title: Medalist Movie
title_japanese: メダリスト 劇場版
synopsis: Sequel to Medalist 2nd Season.

title: FX Senshi Kurumi-chan
synopsis:
When middle school student, Fukuga Kurumi's mother commits suicide after losing 20 million yen in FX trading (Foreign Exchange trading), she vows to recoup the money her mother lost "I'll easily get that much back!"

Now, when she is a university student she makes her long-awaited debut in FX trading, unaware that the world she just entered could turn from heaven to hell in the blink of an eye.

This is a cute and slightly dangerous story as it explains technical terms by thrilling market fluctuations as the chart drives up and down, which becomes more heated with the entry of quirky FX warriors: Yasuko Takane, Mochiko Kogane, and Mebuki Yamashi. Can Kurumi and her friends survive this world with unstoppable heartbeat moments and unrealized losses!?

(Source: MAL News)

title: World Is Dancing
title_japanese: ワールド イズ ダンシング
synopsis:
One does not need dance to live.

In 1374, during the turbulent age when the Northern and Southern Courts were locked in conflict, the Northern Court's shogun, Ashikaga Yoshimitsu, was becoming an increasingly dominant force.

Born the son of Kanami, head of the Kanze troupe of sarugaku performers, Oniyasha drifts through his days with a hazy question lodged in his heart: Why do people dance? His spirit remains clouded, until the day he encounters a dance that is truly "good."

Curious, sensitive, and strikingly beautiful, the boy meets people, laughs, cries, confronts his own weaknesses, and slowly begins to shape a new form of dance for a world steeped in impermanence.

(Source: Shochiku)

title: Doukyo Shiteiru Kensei no Onna Shishou ga Kawaisugite Mainichi Shiawase desu
title_japanese: 同居している剣聖の女師匠が可愛すぎて毎日幸せです
synopsis:
Eugene Dawson, a lad who aims to get stronger, is currently training under his master, Liza Pulsandra, who is extolled as the Sword Saint. His days are spent happily with his master, who is the strongest in terms of physical strength, but whose private life is a bit of a mess. Or so one would think, but her undefended and erotic body and unconscious physical contact make something like training seem impossible...!? Can he really get stronger like this?

(Source: Kadokawa, translated)

title: Onegai AiPri
synopsis:
The new anime's story centers on Konomi Inori, a first year middle school student who just moved to the town of Onegai. At the town's plaza, Konomi prayed to the goddess statue to give her a chance to be an AiPri. After she prayed, she accidentally meets the famous AiPri Aoi Yumemiya and a mysterious talking stuffed toy with her named Fortu. It turns out that Fortu is looking for an AiPri who can make their wish come true, and when Konomi opened the special mirror pact that Aoi handed her, she gets the AiPri debut that she prayed for. 

(Source: ANN)

title: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Pantan to Yakusoku no Hoshi
title_japanese: それいけ！アンパンマン パンタンと約束の星
synopsis:
The film will center on a new character named Pantan. Pantan is a red panda who seeks to find the treasure thought to be in a rainbow star in the night sky, in order to keep a promise made to an adventurer long ago. When Pantan and Anpanman encounter each other, Anpanman lends his abilities to help out Pantan.

(Source: ANN)

title: Kimi to Hanabi to Yakusoku to
synopsis:
Set around the Nagaoka Festival Grand Fireworks Show, one of Japan's three major fireworks displays, this story follows two high school students, Makoto and Akira.

Though they live far apart in Tokyo and have never met, their lives are unexpectedly brought together by a single, mysterious painting of a firework. Drawn together by this strange connection, the two grow closer as time runs short. As the festival approaches, Makoto and Akira are faced with a decision that will change their futures forever.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Dragon Ball Super: Beerus
title_japanese: ドラゴンボール超 ビルス
synopsis:
Dragon Ball Super: Beerus, a project that was started a few years ago, is the newly ENHANCED edition of the anime Dragon Ball Super. ENHANCED by the latest visual expression, every scene, especially the battle scenes, is even more immersive, providing a more faithful and detailed reproduction of the original work by Akira Toriyama, and it will deliver a quality that is sure to fully satisfy audiences.

(Source: Official website)

title: Nippon Sangoku
title_english: Nippon Sangoku: The Three Nations of the Crimson Sun
producers: Sound Team Don Juan|Twin Engine|Amazon MGM Studios
synopsis:
In the near future, Japan has completely collapsed due to a mix of nuclear warfare, natural disasters, and widespread corruption that sparked a revolution.

The country is now split into three warring superpowers. This new era of the Three Kingdoms Period sees diplomacy vanish, replaced by a harsh, relentless fight for power. Each territory is using its military strength and resources against the others in a desperate attempt for total control over the remnants of Japanese land.

Aoteru Misumi is a low-ranking official who has stayed in the background for most of his life. He does not come from a prestigious military background or aristocracy, but Misumi has a strong ambition: to end the pointless bloodshed that afflicts the nation. He seeks to unify the fractured country, armed only with sharp insight and a persuasive voice that can rally the people.

The legend of the man who will become a brilliant military strategist starts now.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Megami "Isekai Tensei Nani ni Naritai desu ka" Ore "Yuusha no Rokkotsu de"
title_japanese: 女神「異世界転生何になりたいですか」俺「勇者の肋骨で」
producers: Movic|Magic Capsule|Nippon Television Network|Docomo Anime Store|Nippon Television Music|BS NTV|Takarajimasha
synopsis:
The protagonist of the tale, simply referred to as "I," experiences an endless cycle of reincarnation. The narrative takes place in a different universe where people are free to select their next form. However, the waiting list for popular roles, like "Demon King" or "Hero with Cheat Skills and a Harem," has reached 50,000 years due to a recent spike in applications.

The protagonist decides to repeatedly reincarnate into increasingly strange forms because he refuses to wait. These roles include the rib of a hero in charge of a harem, a hermit crab, a vegetable, and even an explosive used to blow up blissfully happy couples.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Mouse Cursor de Genjitsu wo Sousa Dekiru You ni Natta node, Onna no Ko wo Ippai Click Shima~su
title_japanese: マウスカーソルで現実を操作できるようになったので、女の子をいっぱいクリックしまーす
synopsis:
What if you could actually use a mouse cursor in real life? Takumi, the nerdy outcast, harbors unrequited feelings for his first love, Mone, who treats him with disdain. During computer class, Takumi discovers that his mouse cursor extends beyond the screen and into the physical world...?! With this newfound power visible only to him, Takumi sees an opportunity for mischief. He uses the cursor to get revenge on Mone, clicking on sensitive areas and reveling in her reactions. But when an "Intercourse" button appears unexpectedly, Takumi is thrust into a reality he never imagined possible..."Intercourse"?! Could this really be...?!

(Source: Coolmic)

title: Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei Naru Musouroku
title_japanese: 凶乱令嬢ニア・リストン 病弱令嬢に転生した神殺しの武人の華麗なる無双録
synopsis:
Lying on her deathbed with seemingly no chance at recovery, a young Nia Liston is soon to succumb to her illness. Unable to give up hope, her parents desperately search for a cure in even the most obscure places, leading to the appearance of a hooded man claiming he can help rid Nia of her condition. But rather than curing her, the hooded man transplants the soul of a deceased hero who was undefeated in battle into the girl's frail body.

Given a second chance at life as Nia, the hero is determined to recover her new body's strength by using a technique known as chi to target and eliminate the illness at its roots. With her enthusiastic hunger for combat having also been carried over, Nia is eager to return to exploring the world. However, the hero's restless soul yearns to find a worthy opponent who can defeat her on the battlefield, sparking chaos wherever Nia may go.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Kyouryuu Chou Densetsu 2: Darwin ga Kita Movie!
title_japanese: 恐竜超伝説2 劇場版ダーウィンが来た！

title: Yani Neko
synopsis:
Yani is a catgirl with a seriously bad smoking habit. She smokes so much that her apartment smells like ash and is littered with cigarette butts—and plenty of other trash! Every time she tries to quit, she becomes weak to the cravings and gives in almost instantly. Will she ever get her life together, or is she doomed to live as a chainsmoking slob forever?

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

title: Doumo, Suki na Hito ni Horegusuri wo Irai sareta Majo desu.
title_english: I'm a Witch Who's Crush Requested a Love Potion
title_japanese: どうも、好きな人に惚れ薬を依頼された魔女です。
synopsis:
Deep within the forest, a cozy and rather cluttered cottage sits on the lakeshore, housing a mysterious, feared witch. In truth, she is a lovely young woman named Rose, who has learned the art of potion-making from her wise grandmother. Rose cherishes her tucked-away life, yet there is a longing in her heart—for a handsome knight she once saw, Sir Harij Azm.

For four years, Rose's feelings for Harij have lingered, but she can never act on them; witches live outside of human affairs and belong to no country or man. So, when Harij suddenly appears on her doorstep looking for a love potion, Rose is both surprised and heartbroken. Although another woman has captured the noble knight's heart, Rose decides to help him. But before crafting the potion, Rose sends Harij on a series of ridiculous quests for each ingredient, hoping to delay the inevitable and savor their fleeting time together.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Mairimashita! Iruma-kun: If Episode of Mafia
title_japanese: 魔入りました!入間くん if Episode of 魔フィア
synopsis:
In this brand-new spinoff of the runaway hit series, Iruma is a dirt-poor but unfailingly cheerful young boy who grows up in a ruthless city slum. One day, Iruma gives an injured old man his last loaf of bread and nurses the stranger back to health—only to find out that the elder gent is none other than Don Sullivan, head of the Babyl Mafia! Soon after, Don Sullivan comes back, whisks Iruma away, and begs the boy to become his grandson. And just like that, Iruma begins his new life as the next in line to lead a gigantic gang of—dare we say—demonic mafiosos!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Doko yori mo Tooi Basho ni Iru Kimi e
title_japanese: どこよりも遠い場所にいる君へ
synopsis:
Kazuki Tsukigase is a high school boy who carries a certain secret. In search of a place where no one knows him, he enrolls at Sakijima High School on a remote island.

On Sakijima, there is a place known as the "Cove of Spiriting Away." One early summer day, Kazuki finds a girl lying unconscious in the cove. The girl—Nanao, 16 years old—later regains consciousness in the hospital, but her identity remains unknown. What is the meaning behind the word "1974" that she murmured?

A touching boy-meets-girl story.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Yuukyuu no Gusha Asley no, Kenja no Susume
title_japanese: 悠久の愚者アズリーの、賢者のすゝめ
synopsis:
When Asley was young, he had dropped from the Magic Academy and was looked down by others. However by chance, he discovered a god medicine and obtained an immortal body. In order to take revenge on the people who made fun of him, he started to work on the research of magic and magical artifacts much different from those developed in the academy, and before he even noticed, 5000 years have passed and he became an ancient magic user.

Losing his purpose life, Asley goes out on a journey with his familiar, Pochi, to see the world after 5000 years. With an unexpected turns of events after helping many humans, he is now living at the Magic Academy...

How a 5000-year-old with young appearance Asley will live his second life?

(Source: Official site)

title: Xiong Chumo: Niannian You Xiong
synopsis:
Briar, Bramble and Vick encounter the legendary Year Monster, Nian, who bestows them with mysterious powers, thrusting them into the hidden, chaotic, magic-infused realm of Eve City.

(Source: IMDb)

title: Xi Yangyang Yu Hui Tailang: Gu Guguai Jie You Guguai
title_japanese: 喜羊羊与灰太狼之古古怪界有古怪
synopsis:
The anion and cation orbs were stolen by a mysterious wolf pack, pointing the finger of danger directly at the Strange Realm. The sheep and wolves tracked them down to the Strange Realm, only to discover that Handsome Guy and Black General had also been captured and taken to the Inner Earth beneath it. To rescue the two eggs, the sheep and wolves resolutely set off for the Inner Earth. In their adventures through the layers of the Inner Earth, the sheep and wolves met various explorers, fought against unknown monsters, and braved mysterious dangers. After countless battles and intrigues, the sheep and wolves finally uncovered the conspiracy of the ruthless preserved egg factory, rescued Handsome Guy and Black General, and, with the help of the two eggs, thwarted the crisis caused by the wolf pack, protecting the peace of the Inner Earth.

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

title: Tsuihou sareta Cheat Fuyo Majutsushi wa Kimama na Second Life wo Ouka suru. Ore wa Buki dake ja Naku, Arayuru Mono ni "Kyouka Point" wo Fuyo Dekiru shi, Ore no Ishi de Itsudemo Kouka wo Kaijo Dekiru kedo, Nokotta Hitotachi Daijoubu?
title_japanese: 追放されたチート付与魔術師は気ままなセカンドライフを謳歌する。 ～俺は武器だけじゃなく、あらゆるものに『強化ポイント』を付与できるし、俺の意思でいつでも効果を解除できるけど、残った人たち大丈夫？～
synopsis:
Rein, an enchanter who strengthens equipment with his magic, is suddenly expelled from his guild, simply because every piece of gear in the guild has already been enhanced enough. Outraged by the absurd treatment, Rein decides to take back the enormous amount of mana he had poured into their equipment. When he casually channels it into a random copper sword, it transforms into a cheat-level weapon with 10,000 enhancement points!

With zero combat experience but armed with magic that can turn anything into overpowered gear, this enchanter sets off to enjoy a new, carefree life as an adventurer!

(Source: Shochiku)

title: Daikenja Riddle no Jikan Gyakkou
title_english: The Regression of Great Sage Riddle
title_japanese: 大賢者リドルの時間逆行
synopsis:
A young man named Riddle had lost all of his friends—and the entire world—at the hands of a mysterious organization known as the "Box of Malice." Having lost all hope to live, he dwelled in a pit of despair until he has one final revelation. What if... he could return to a time before everything ended? And so, after a thousand years, a deformed Riddle finally manages to reverse time. "I'm going to stop them this time...!" Equipped with a thousand years of knowledge and experience in his young body, the Great Sage Riddle's journey to the past now unfolds!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Chaoji Fei Xia Wenhua Zhonghua
synopsis: A special season of Super Wings set in entirely in China.

title: Buonomo no Busutaman
title_japanese: ボーノーモのブスタマン
synopsis:
Have you ever wanted to swap your face for a new one If it was easy to do - as easy, quick and cheap as buying a burger at McDonald's - everyone would do it. As soon as you get tired of one, just get another. But there is something you should bear in mind. In order to get a new face, you must first throw away your old one.

(Source: Official Site)

title: Ushiro no Shoumen Kamui-san
title_japanese: うしろの正面カムイさん
synopsis:
Shizuka is a normal high school girl with the ability to see ghosts. Due to her peculiar tendency to attract ghosts, she works as an assistant to Kamui, a famous psychic. Kamui takes pride in his top-notch psychic abilities, but the way he exorcises ghosts is rather unusual!

(Source: Shogakukan, translated)

title: Hyakki Yakoushou
synopsis:
Ritsu inherited his sixth sense from his grandfather, along with a demon guardian named Blue Storm. Strange things just seem to happen around these two, and it's left to them to get to the bottom of all these mysterious events. Each story is independent but features recurring characters you'll come to know and appreciate as they, each in their own way, try to deal with things 'not of this world'.

(Source: MU)

title: Namidaame to Serenade
synopsis:
On rainy days, Hina Katagiri always dreams about her younger self playing with a mysterious boy, but she assumes these thoughts are nothing more than a childhood fantasy. Now a high school student, she focuses on her club activities and protecting her great-grandmother's necklace.

While at school, Hina is inexplicably transported to the backyard of a mansion, where she is greeted by one of its inhabitants, Takaaki Hongou. He mistakes the girl for his fiancée, Hinako Kitamine, but Hina, believing she is in a dream, plays along with the misunderstanding. It is when Hina comes face-to-face with the real Hinako that she realizes the severity of her situation: somehow, she has been sent to the year 1907. In addition, she has lost her heirloom necklace at Takaaki's house. With Hinako's assistance, Hina continues to masquerade as her in order to access the Hongou household. However, Hina's plan begins to fall apart when she starts to develop feelings for Takaaki, all while the path to her fo

title: Odebu Akujo ni Tensei shitara, Nazeka Last Boss Oujisama ni Shuuchaku sareteimasu
title_japanese: おデブ悪女に転生したら、なぜかラスボス王子様に執着されています
synopsis:
After dying of illness, she has been reincarnated as Celine, the selfish, fat, villainous duchess, sister of the heroine of a popular novel. If she stays this way, she will be killed by the hero prince and die a miserable death, just as in the novel. She vows to reform herself with all her might and begins to struggle, but she finds herself caught up in unexpected doting and obsession! Will Celine be able to find "peaceful happiness"?

A fantasy love story about a reincarnation in another world where she is loved too much by a yandere.

(Source: NHN comico Corp.)

title: Sora wa Akai Kawa no Hotori
synopsis:
Yuri, a pretty Japanese girl, is ecstatic after passing her college entrance exam and having her first kiss with her childhood friend-turned boyfriend. However, her luck soon changes. She starts to notice that water becomes agitated whenever she goes near it. One night, hands appear out of a puddle on the street and drag her into the water! Transported to an ancient village in the Middle East, she is then captured by armed troops and taken to the Queen's palace for a human sacrifice.

(Source: VIZ Media)

title: AI Shitteru
synopsis:
A reality dating program from Gyeonggi-do that is airing in 2070. "Find true love through the attraction of your heart!" AI and human panelists date solely through conversation. "You can tell whether the other person is an AI or a human by declaring that you are in love."

(Source: Vimeo, translated)

title: Rakudai Kenja no Gakuin Musou: Nidome no Tensei, S-Rank Cheat Majutsushi Boukenroku
title_japanese: 落第賢者の学院無双～二度目の転生、Sランクチート魔術師冒険録～
synopsis:
The Sage of Wind, Ephtal is a reincarnated human, coming from modern Earth. Reincarnated in a new world where magic is real, he decides to devote the entirety of his life in the pursuit of magic. Despite his efforts, though, he discovers that he is absolutely talentless in magic, and breathed his last in anguish.

But it isn't the end for him just yet! He reincarnates once again bearing the same name, Ephtal, 400 years later. Having retained his knowledge and power, he steels his resolve and once again sets his sights for the peak of magic!

However, in a surprising turn of events, he discovers that magic has terribly declined. In this era where powerful spells are a rarity, his talentless self is now completely unmatched! From the depths of powerlessness to the peak of power, the talentless but peerless mage's journey to the top starts now!

(Source: Manga UP!, edited)

title: Mahoutsukai Rosé no Sado Life
title_japanese: 魔法使いロゼの佐渡ライフ
synopsis:
The story begins when Rosé is transported from another world to Japan. Right after arriving, she is attacked by a bird, but she's saved by a local resident named Sana Tsuchiya.

Since Rosé has just arrived and lacks both money and any sense of her surroundings, she ends up moving in with Sana. At first, after watching TV at Sana's house, Rosé assumes she has been transported to Tokyo—but in reality, she is on Sado Island.

(Source: MAL News)

title: "Kimi wo Aisuru Ki wa Nai" to Itta Jiki Koushaku-sama ga Nazeka Dekiai shitekimasu
title_japanese: 『きみを愛する気はない』と言った次期公爵様がなぜか溺愛してきます
synopsis:
Elsa, daughter of a fallen aristocrat, receives a marriage proposal from Julius, an elite aristocrat. "Why would such a noble man marry me?" Elsa was perplexed, but after the wedding, Julius, who until then had been kind and gentle, changed his mind!

(Source: Flex Comix, translated)

title: Zeikin de Katta Hon
synopsis:
Ishidaira is a delinquent who visited the library for the first time since elementary school. He discovered that he still hadn't returned a book he borrowed 10 years ago. He ended up having to work part-time at the library to pay for it. This is the beginning of a manga that makes you want to go to the library after you read it.

(Source: Kodansha, translated)

title: Kin to Tetsu
synopsis:
Dante's life on Amigasa seemed normal enough to him, even though everyone around him called him an oddball. But when a chance meeting with a young woman named Aoi changes everything, Dante can no longer sit idly by...unless, of course, he is made to!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Hone Dragon no Mana Musume
synopsis:
In the Forest of Scraps, a place where all manner of things are discarded, an old dragon sleeps away his final days—that is, until an abandoned child suddenly appears before him. The tiny human is Eve, and despite being only five years of age, she has somehow endured the many dangers that surround them. In an act of pity, the dragon decides to raise her as his own...but his time is still running out.

After five years together, he takes his last breath, leaving his precious daughter on her own. Little does the dragon know, Eve is capable of more than he realizes, and their reunion may be sooner than he thinks...

Hoping to improve Eve's control over her magical abilities before his resurrected body gives out, the skull dragon sets out on an adventure with his reckless human daughter—but who knows what kind of trouble awaits them?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Onaji Semi no Someya-san ga Sexy Joyuu datta Hanashi.
title_english: My Classmate's a Sexy Actress, and Now We Live Together?!
title_japanese: 同じゼミの染谷さんがセクシー女優だった話。

title: Bless
synopsis:
In a boisterous classroom, 15-year-old Aia Udagawa's thoughts are far from the topic at hand. While his classmates select him as a model for the Aoi Festival Artist Contest due to his past modeling experience, Udagawa watches Jun Sumisaki, a tall and awkward girl who seems embarrassed about her unique freckles and impressive height. They are paired as model and stylist—but Udagawa defeatedly mourns his abandoned dream of becoming a makeup artist.

Udagawa has long convinced himself he has no talent, and Sumisaki lacks the confidence to hold her head high and flaunt her stunning features. Even so, Sumisaki proposes that they switch: Udagawa will have all creative freedom, and she will boldly strut the runway like her mother once taught her. Notable figures from the glamor industry will be watching, but it may prove to be the push Udagawa needs to return to the fashion and beauty scene and conquer it alongside his favorite model.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]

title: Planosaurus Gachi Koseibutsu-bu
title_japanese: プラノサウルス ガチコセイブツ部

title: Football Animals
title_japanese: フットボールアニマル
synopsis:
Only one minute left in the second half. The RED ANIMALS are slick, pushing through the deadly defensive line of the BLUE BEASTS. And just when you think it's all over, the ball goes up in the air. Who will smell sweet victory?

(Source: YouTube)

title: Mao he Lao Shu: Xing Pan qi Yuan
synopsis:
Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass follows the iconic cat-and-mouse duo as they accidentally travel through time in a museum. Along their journey, they meet a group of intriguing new companions and become involved in a final showdown with mysterious forces.

(Source: Deadline)

title: J⇔Ｍ
synopsis:
J is a legendary hitman who is feared in the underworld as "untouchable." One day, while walking on the street, he accidentally collides into a lonely elementary school girl named Megumi. However, because of the accident, they switch bodies.

J is now forced to go through the life of the schoolgirl Megumi, while Megumi is now forced to go through the life of the hitman J. One chaotic and comical situation after another ensues as they go through each other's life.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Game Sekai Tensei "Dankatsu": Gamer wa "Dungeon Shuukatsu no Susume" wo "Hajime kara" Play suru
title_japanese: ゲーム世界転生〈ダン活〉～ゲーマーは【ダンジョン就活のススメ】を〈はじめから〉プレイする
synopsis:
After finding himself reincarnated as the protagonist of the god-tier game "Dungeon Job Hunting Recommendation", aka "DanKatsu", Zephyrus is far from intimidated. Instead, he's absolutely thrilled! As a seasoned gamer who knows every nook and cranny of this world, he now has the chance to live within a massive system featuring an unprecedented 1,021 playable classes and over 400 different endings.

Armed with an encyclopedic knowledge of the game's mechanics, Zephyrus wastes no time enrolling in the Labyrinth Academy, the central stage where the real adventure begins. He has his sights set on a single goal: securing the fabled "Hero" class. Alongside his childhood friend, whom he guides toward the Alchemist path, Zephyrus is ready to sweep up rare loot and power-level at a breakneck pace!

(Source: MAL News)

title: Komekami! Girls
synopsis:
This is the story of the seven-sister unit "Komekami! Girls," children of the rice deity, born from the tradition: "In a single grain of rice, seven gods reside."

When their mother(the deity of rice, or the rice-god queen) was called back in haste to the celestial realm and no longer able to return to the earthly realm they search for her traces using Usa City (Oita Prefecture) as their base, and teleport to Hachiman shrines throughout Kyushu island. As they solve local problems, they learn about food, take part in cooking battles, and grow.

title: Tensei Goblin dakedo Shitsumon Aru?
title_japanese: 転生ゴブリンだけど質問ある？
synopsis:
Office worker Akira Yagami's altruistic nature usually gets him the short end of the stick. When he dies after saving a kid from oncoming traffic...he reincarnates in another world as a goblin?! Normally, goblins only live for seven days, but Akira's newfound powers let him defy the species' normal life span... and are the key to his path to becoming the strongest goblin ever!

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Junket Bank
synopsis:
Karasu Bank is one of Japan's leading banks, boasting the third-highest operating profits in the country. Akira Mitarai is a young employee in his second year at the bank's central branch. His exceptional math skills allow him to instantly spot accounting errors but also make his day-to-day life incredibly boring.

One day, Akira is suddenly transferred to the Special Operations Department's "Appraisal Unit," which he is told is a key department within the bank. Suspicious of his transfer and the unfamiliar department, he is told by his new boss that the bank actually operates a massive underground casino, and that the Appraisal Unit is the department responsible for managing this gambling as well as the gamblers who participate in it. But these gamblers are putting more than just their money on the line, with their very lives serving as collateral to play! Higher risk means higher rewards, but at the top level losing is a death sentence.

Overwhelmed and confused by the strange state

title: Isekai Tensei Soudouki
synopsis:
Bard Cornelius: the son of a nobleman of Mauricia, an empire located in a parallel universe. But Bard is no ordinary boy—he's got three souls packed into one body! Aside from his own consciousness, he's got Oka Sanai, a miserly samurai, and Masaharu Oka, a high school otaku who loves animal ears. With his extra knowledge of military tactics and business acumen, Bard's ready to cheat his way to the top! Get ready to enjoy the manga version of this hit isekai light novel series!

(Source: One Peace Books)

title: Sword Art Online: Unanswered//butterfly
synopsis:
The world's first full-dive VRMMO, Sword Art Online—known as SAO. What was meant to be a dream come true has instead transformed into a deadly game where dying in the virtual world means dying in reality.

Emirun and Rex, who once knew each other in the real world, reunite by chance within SAO. They join a scouting party to learn how to survive in this unforgiving world. One day, however, they encounter a mysterious PK (Player Killer) known only as the Black Swordsman. When Emirun rushes to the scene, she finds Rex collapsed in despair, and the Black Swordsman standing over him. The one who wiped out their entire scouting party—was the Black Swordsman.

Determined to avenge their fallen comrades, Emirun and Rex seek out the legendary prodigy swordswoman Asuna, and begin intense training under her guidance. In a death game where even players turn against one another, what new beginning will these two reach at the end of their struggle…?

(Source: Official Site, translated)

title: Moshi, Korekara Umareru no Nara
title_japanese: もし、これから生まれるのなら
synopsis:
Nameless twins land on a certain planet. Led by a guide, they venture into a mysterious world in search of their mother, whom they have never met. However, their path begins to crumble under the weight of their mother's grief.

(Source: Official site, translated)

title: Tank Chair
synopsis:
Shizuka takes on the most dangerous of assassin jobs, but she's not the one doing the killing. Rather, it's her brother, Nagi, a strong assassin who took a bullet to protect his sister, leaving him in a comatose state and having to use a wheelchair. However, Shizuka has figured out the key to waking her brother up: he must be faced with killing intent! Thus begins a violent journey of recovery, battling the most dangerous foes!

(Source: Kodansha USA)

title: Suterare Seijo no Isekai Gohan Tabi: Kakure Skill de Camping Car wo Shoukan shimashita
title_english: The Forsaken Saintess and her Foodie Roadtrip in Another World
title_japanese: 捨てられ聖女の異世界ごはん旅 隠れスキルでキャンピングカーを召喚しました
synopsis:
Rin Takanashi, a caregiver in her thirties, was unceremoniously discarded as "trash" despite being summoned as a saint.

However, as a lover of the great outdoors and all things camping, she was blessed with a special skill, [Survival], as well as another unique skill! Thus, a riveting tale begins: one of sweat, tears, and insatiable hunger as Rin, together with companions she picked up along the way, leisurely explores this parallel world and savors gourmet cuisine to her heart's content...

Or so the story should have gone, but it looks like their road is going in an unexpected direction...?

(Source: MU)

title: Kanata kara
synopsis:
Noriko Tachiki has dreamt of a beautiful fantasy land for some time, though her friends think it is only her imagination. One day, on her way home, Noriko stumbles upon a bomb disguised as a paper bag that explodes right in front of her. However, instead of dying, she is transported to a mysterious forest full of strange plants and creatures.

As she begins navigating through the woods, Noriko is suddenly attacked by a giant, worm-like monster. Fortunately, she is saved by Izark Kia Tarj, a swordsman who does not speak her language. Lacking the strength to survive on her own, Noriko decides to follow her stoic savior, taking the opportunity to learn the foreign land's language and be more useful to Izark.

Unbeknownst to her, Noriko is a crucial piece of an ancient prophecy. She is "The Awakening"—a being destined to unleash the greatest evil known as the "Sky Demon." With influential people plotting to capture Noriko for her supposed powers, both she and Izark must fend for themselves

title: Shiotaiou no Satou-san ga Ore ni dake Amai
title_english: The Cold Sato-san is Only Sweet to Me
title_japanese: 塩対応の佐藤さんが俺にだけ甘い
synopsis:
Koharu Satou is known to her classmates as the "unattainable flower" a cold and distant girl whose refusal to smile keeps everyone at arm's length.

However, Souta Oshio accidentally stumbles upon Satou's secret at her family's cafe. It turns out the "icy Satou-san" is actually an incredibly shy and clumsy girl who struggles even with something as simple as taking photos of sweets for the cafe's social media.

Bonding over their shared love for cameras and desserts, the distance between the two gradually shrinks. This charming romantic comedy follows two socially awkward people as they navigate their feelings in a story that is as sweet as it is endearing.

(Source: MAL News)

title: Zatsuyou Fuyo Jutsushi ga Jibun no Saikyou ni Kizuku made
title_english: Magical Buffs: The Support Caster Is Stronger Than He Realized!
title_japanese: 雑用付与術師が自分の最強に気付くまで
synopsis:
Wim Strauss is a "granting caster"—a support mage who can increase the strength of his allies through the power of his spells. It's a useful talent, but since it can't be used directly in battle, it gets zero respect from the other members of his party. As far as they're concerned, support magic is dead weight. It isn't long before they toss him out on his ear, leaving Wim to wonder if his career as an adventurer is over.

Lucky for Wim, he has one big chance: his childhood friend Heidemarie is able to get him an audition with her elite A-rank party, Nachtlibelle. The two of them know his magic is good for more than just menial backup, but now he'll have to prove it. It's time to show the world that support mages can do more than just stand on the back lines!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

synopsis: Araki, Stella, and Olga, three high school students, live in the downtown area. They lead an unplanned life—playing games, going to the public bath, and returning home. This is a story of their everyday life… or is it?

synopsis: Third season of Sousou no Frieren.

title: Xi You Ji (2010)
title_english: Monkey, Monk, and the Monsters Go West
synopsis:
It tells the story of the four disciples—Tang Sanzang, Sun Wukong, Zhu Bajie, and Sha Wujing—on their long journey to obtain Buddhist scriptures, where they vanquish demons and monsters. The entire series is humorous, witty, and full of imagination.

(Source: Baidu Baike, translated)

title: Love Live! Hasunosora Jogakuin School Idol Club
title_japanese: ラブライブ！蓮ノ空女学院スクールアイドルクラブ
synopsis: A TV anime for Love Live! Hasunosora Jogakuin School Idol Club.

title: King of Prism: Dramatic Prism.1
synopsis: Movie version of King of Prism: Shiny Seven Stars with new content.

title: Migawari Reijou wo Sukutta no wa Reikoku Mujihi na Koori no Ouji no Ai deshita
title_japanese: 身代わり令嬢を救ったのは冷酷無慈悲な氷の王子の愛でした
synopsis:
As the illegitimate daughter of a count and his maid, Katrina was born into miserable circumstances. And now that she's lost her mother, the treatment from her stepsister and stepmother the countess has only grown worse. One day, her stepsister receives a royal order to move to the northern outskirts due to her unseemly behavior at a recent party. There, she is to learn proper conduct under the tutelage of the resident prince, rumored to be a cruel man. Not wanting to subject her daughter to such punishment, the countess decides to send Katrina instead. Katrina arrives in the north shaking in fear. But contrary to the stories, the "merciless and cold-hearted" prince is kinder than she believed. Might the pure-hearted Katrina find love in the wintry countryside?

(Source: MangaPlaza)

title: Ganbare Rockman: Jishin Youjin - Hi no Youjin
title_japanese: がんばれロックマン 地震用心・火の用心
synopsis: The fire and earthquake safety short film that was briefly screened in Japan in the early 1990s and never received a home video release.

title: Meitantei Precure! Movie
title_japanese: 映画 名探偵プリキュア！

title: Cardfight!! Vanguard: Divinez Unmei Seisen-hen
title_japanese: カードファイト!! ヴァンガード DivineZ 運命星戦編
synopsis: Final Arc of Cardfight!! Vanguard: D Series.

title: Majo to Youhei
synopsis:
Zig—a tall, broad-shouldered mercenary—participates in a witch hunt. Following a fierce duel with the deadly witch, he becomes privy to her desire. "I want you to protect me," she requests, tired of having her life trivialized. Seeking a place to survive, the witch and the mercenary set their sights on an unknown continent!

(Source: Kodansha)

title: Cheongchun Blossom: Uliui Bom
synopsis:
Oh, to be young and in love. Oh, to be wild and carefree. The springtime of life is intense, tumultuous, and at times, oh so confusing. Spring, summer, fall and winter—love blossoms in all seasons.

(Source: Webtoon Entertainment)

title: Pen to Wappa to Jijitsukon
title_english: A Pen, Handcuffs, and a Common-Law Marriage
synopsis:
Forty-year-old detective Eiji Kirisame has found maybe the strangest witness of his life: a silent high school girl named Tsugumi Kuchinashi who was at the scene of the crime. Her statements mostly consist of shoddy doodles on a drawing pad, but Eiji is no stranger to piecing together the truth from limited evidence. He'll take every page seriously if it might help solve the case. But why does the last page say... "Will you marry me?!"

(Source: Yen Press)

title: Shiranuhi
synopsis:
The short is set in a coastal town in Kumamoto at the tail end of summer 1996. The 10-year-old boy Minato lives a precarious life with his drunkard father. Minato's only source of strength is Ben-chan, a goddess in the form of a young girl that appeared in Benten Island. The time he spends with her are the only times where he feels like himself. But when he is about to be separated from Ben-chan due to being sent to a children's home, Minato prays to a Shiranuhi, a mysterious light floating above the sea, to grant him one wish. His wish, filled with hatred towards his father, eventually becomes a curse.

(Source: Anime News Network)

title: Biblia Koshodou no Jiken Techou
title_english: The Case Files of Biblia Bookstore
title_japanese: ビブリア古書堂の事件手帖
synopsis:
Hidden away in a corner of Kamakura is an unassuming secondhand bookstore, the Biblia Antiquarian Bookshop. Shinokawa Shioriko, the owner of the shop, is an overly shy young and beautiful woman who doesn't fit the image of a used bookstore and often has trouble interacting with customers.

While customer service isn't her strong point, she more than makes up for it in other ways. Using her exhaustive knowledge and unrivaled passion for literature, she unravels the secrets and mysteries of the antiquarian books that come into her shop.

This is a story of secrets and rare books.

(Source: Nanodesu Translation)

title: Around 40 Kenja no Isekai Seikatsu Nikki
title_japanese: アラフォー賢者の異世界生活日記
synopsis:
Forty-year-old Satoshi Osako is a farmer in the Japanese countryside—and a hardcore player of Swords & Sorceries, an online VRRPG. The day he finally manages to defeat the game's final boss, it curses him with its dying breath and kills him in real life! With a little help from a carefree goddess, Satoshi finds himself reincarnated into a mysterious new world as his in-game character, the incredibly powerful Great Sage known as Zelos Merlin. He accordingly decides to use his newfound powers to...continue living a quiet life on another farm! But first, he'll have to fight his way out of the vast, dangerous forest he woke up in—thanks a lot, goddess—and it won't be long before he's running into bandits, getting roped into teaching a young noble girl magic, and more. Will the almighty Great Sage be able to conquer the toughest quest of all: getting some peace and quiet?

(Source: J-Novel Club)

title: Ginga Tetsudou 999: Glass no Clair 3D
title_english: Galaxy Express 999: Claire of the Glass 3D
title_japanese: 銀河鉄道999～ガラスのクレア～（3D）
synopsis: CG remake of the Ginga Tetsudou 999: Glass no Clair short movie.

title: Megane, Tokidoki, Yankee-kun
title_japanese: メガネ、時々、ヤンキーくん
synopsis:
In middle school, Hiro Momose was bullied and forced to be an errand girl for delinquents. Now a high school freshman, she is hoping to turn over a new leaf. Although the requirement states that each student must join a club, the clumsy Hiro is rejected by every club she has visited. Because of this, she ends up joining the "Helper's Club," a group on the verge of disbanding with Dan Ichikura as its sole member.

On the surface, Ichikura seems like the perfect boy—boasting good grades, athleticism, and a reliable nature. However, he harbors a secret that hits a bit too close to home for Hiro: he was once a delinquent. When she finds out, Ichikura swears her to secrecy. Now, Hiro must avoid returning to her middle school days and make this chance encounter work out for them both.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
